title: An Act to Protect Domestic Workers

summary.text: This bill establishes occupational health and safety standards for domestic workers by directing the Department of Labor, Bureau of Labor Standards to adopt rules regulating the employment of domestic workers, requiring employers and employees to sign an employment contract and stipulating the rest breaks required for domestic workers and limitations on work hours. The bill also establishes penalties and enforcement for violations of these provisions.
